# Tagwimi

> Make the plan. Find your people. Go.

Tagwimi is an adults-only (18+) social web app that helps people in Kampala create and join small, specific activity plans at real places and times — swims, walks, coffee, events, and similar meetups.

## Product

- Browse open activity plans around Kampala
- Create a plan with a public venue, time, and group size
- Request to join; hosts accept before group chat opens
- Coordinate in chat, check in, and mark plans complete
- Safety-first: public venues, small groups, adults only

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://tagwimi.com/): product overview and join
- [Help](https://tagwimi.com/help): getting started, safety, support
- [Terms](https://tagwimi.com/terms): terms of service
- [Privacy](https://tagwimi.com/privacy): privacy policy
